text:
jordana: FYI the sampleapp just sent 512-dim embeddings to the rerank endpoint and got a dim_mismatch.

mike: Can you paste the request/response?

jordana: POST body (sanitized): {requests:[{id:"q1", embedding:[...512 floats]}], model:"open-embed-x"}
Server 400: "dim_mismatch: got=512 expected=768"

sam: Likely config drift (sampleapp using a 512 quantized variant) or a helper that picked a fast fallback. Also parity issue: Node clients silently pad, Python throws.

lina: Proposal: (1) SDKs must surface model.metadata.embedding_dim; (2) batch helper must validate dims by default and offer pad_mode=(pad|trim|fail); (3) attach Idempotency-Key header to batch calls; (4) require per-item ids for dedupe.

mike: Server changes: accept optional X-Embedding-Dim header, return machine-friendly error for dim_mismatch with expected/got/candidates, and include X-Server-Embed-Dim when it routes to a different variant. Also standardize response fields to `embedding` (single) / `embeddings` (batch).

jordana: I'll open a PR that adds client-side dim validation + sampleapp integration test for mismatch cases.

lina: I'll add a README troubleshooting snippet showing curl with X-Embedding-Dim and an example error payload.

sam: Also change retrier: don't blind-retry batches on ambiguous timeouts; include Idempotency-Key so server can dedupe and retrier only retries on network/5xx according to policy.

devx-bot: Created DEVEX-3456 "embed batch dim validation + idempotency + field parity" and linked this thread.

jordana: resolved for now, will follow up with PR link.
